name: Wakefield

queries.query: Wakefield Council official map GIS land parcels cadastral map
queries.result: First-party results identified Wakefield Council's Local Plan Portal and HM Land Registry's official INSPIRE Index Polygons download service. The HM Land Registry result explicitly lists Wakefield Metropolitan District Council as a local-authority download area; the Council viewer is documented for planning policies and map layers, not cadastral parcels.

queries.query: Wakefield official cadastral parcels land registry map download
queries.result: The official UK source is HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons for England and Wales. The official Wakefield Council pages provide planning-policy and general GIS information, but no first-party local cadastral parcel API was evidenced.

registryEvidence.localCustodian: Wakefield Metropolitan District Council is evidenced as the local authority in the HM Land Registry INSPIRE download index and maintains an official planning map portal; no local cadastral custodian endpoint was found.
registryEvidence.nationalService: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
registryEvidence.basis: The first-party HM Land Registry dataset describes indicative extents and positions of registered freehold properties in England and Wales, with a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID, and lists Wakefield Metropolitan District Council as a downloadable authority area.

requests.outcome: Search-indexed first-party dataset page was available and states that INSPIRE Index Polygons are freehold registered-property extents, divided by local authority, with unique Land Registry-INSPIRE IDs. No owner, address, title, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Direct anonymous fetch redirected repeatedly to the same path; no GML file or download URL was obtained. This is an access failure, not evidence of absent Wakefield coverage.
Returned 'Access denied: You need to provide your API Key'. No API key or credentials were used.

Official Wakefield Local Plan Portal HTML returned. Page describes address/location search, adopted and consultation planning layers, aerial photography, and policy information; it does not evidence a cadastral parcel feature service.
Official Wakefield address-search page returned and describes Local Plan policy-map contents. No parcel geometry or safe native parcel identity was returned.
Official Council page confirms Wakefield District Council is a unitary local authority and lists general downloadable GIS maps, but not cadastral parcel data.
HM Land Registry guidance confirms INSPIRE polygons are indicative registered freehold-property extents and that title plans/registers are needed for full legal detail.
